protocol.action_reconstruction: Exact trainer batch(1,60) actor.sample with initial saved CPU/all-CUDA RNG; every action matches bit-for-bit; direct returned logprob, no inversion or clamp
protocol.physics_reconstruction: Exact initial integration state; every obs/next_obs/flag exact; float32(actual reward) equals archived replay reward; all12800 physics steps retained
protocol.actual_reward_precision: Targets use re-executed float64 actual rewards; source replay stores rounded float32 rewards, both archived
protocol.target: terminal G[t]=r[t]; nonterminal G[t]=r[t]+gamma*(G[t+1]-alpha*logpi[t+1]); complete true-terminal episodes only

interpretation: Fixed-policy empirical terminal return regression on actual pre-update failures; heldout episodes never fit. No actor improvement, new SAC success, or production eligibility claim.
